Use sparkwing to build me a pipeline that lints code before I commit,
then a pipeline that lints after a PR is made and runs through some
status checks - like making sure they didn't violate any of our repo
rules. Examples - you cannot pair sql migrations with code. also build
an image in that pipeline and store it in AWS ECR. Also test the code
from the built image. Oh, and deploy it to a developer ephemeral
environment. When a label is applied - like merge-to-dev, then run a
workflow that resets the dev branch to the prod branch, and then commits
in all the merge-to-dev labeled branches. On that branch when the push
lands we do a build and deploy, but skip tests. Then whenever the branch
is merged into prod, do a build, test, deploy, but run sql migrations
before the deploy, and also have an approval step before the deploy goes
out. Make sure testing fans out into a matrix of 10 workers because
there's a lot of tests to run and it'll probably be a slow step.
